scope: Supplied Gaussian conditional logit mixture arithmetic only; no target arrays, numeric outcomes, forecasts, sampler runs or source admission.
functions: stable separate log CDF and survival
mixture quantiles with share bracket tolerance 1e-10
share mean and component means by deterministic integration
share CRPS and centered mixture-weight influence
unclipped winner Brier and negative log scores

independent_oracles: single Gaussian transformed quantiles and density finite difference
immutable copied vectors and invalid inputs
tiny raw-weight dominating tail in log domain
zero-width nonfinite rejection and fixed two-attempt quadrature cap

limits: Quadrature error estimates are not proof or Monte Carlo uncertainty.
No mixture MCMC diagnostics, scoring-mask handling, actual label reader or promotion logic.
Caller must retain chain/draw coordinates and supply qualified weights.
Metric-specific forecast gates and overall execution contract remain to be selected.

predecessor.disposition: three independently detected numerical boundary defects; original bytes preserved

corrections.issue: Normalized linear weights underflowed and lost a rare-tail-dominating component
corrections.repair: Authoritative normalized logweights formed from raw logweights/logsumexp; both log tails and log density use them.

corrections.issue: Floating-point normalized log-win could be slightly positive and rejected by winner_scores
corrections.repair: Normalize independently computed logCDF and logSF together using logaddexp, only when absolute normalization error <=1e-12. No probability floor or rare-tail subtraction.

corrections.issue: Nonfinite zero-width integrand returned NaN with zero estimated error
corrections.repair: Validate finite endpoint and finite ordered bounds before returning typed zero. Invalid integrand raises ArithmeticError.

record_correction.incorrect_root_v1_claim: The proposal used an incorrect negative SF-difference CRPS influence.
record_correction.conclusion: The original proposal was correct and equivalent to implemented +2*SF*(SF_t-SF). Root misread it. Proposal SHA remains036273e2520f2bb97a4cd89235d9a361f82dcdd75bb60f9fff2a1737c42c4c06.
record_correction.preservation: Original proposal and v1 mistaken verification record retained; this explicit correction supersedes the mistaken assertion. User commentary corrected.
